params.name: workspace_id
params.description: Workspace id or path

params.description: Use the explicit all-workspaces aggregate

params.description: Project IDs or @user; repeatable, requires all_workspaces

params.description: Include metadata-only health for returned sessions

params.description: Omit the exact catalog count for a bounded cursor read

params.description: Exclude always-on main sessions from the page and its total

params.name: exclude_finished_automation
params.description: Exclude settled automation-run sessions; search, type, parent, root, archive=only and later=only reads ignore it

params.description: Exclude every automation job or trigger run session the operator has not prompted, whatever its state; search, type, parent, root, archive=only and later=only reads ignore it

params.description: Filter by exact session state

params.name: type
params.description: Filter by exact session type

params.name: agent
params.description: Filter by exact agent definition name

params.name: subagents
params.description: Subagent session visibility (default include)

params.name: children
params.description: Managed child visibility

params.name: parent
params.description: Filter by exact parent session id

params.name: root
params.description: Filter by exact root session id (includes the root itself)

params.name: worktree
params.description: Filter by exact bound worktree id

params.name: q
params.description: Search session id, name, agent, or provider; title_agent searches visible title and agent

params.name: search_fields
params.description: Select visible title/agent search instead of the default catalog fields

params.name: resumable
params.description: Only list sessions eligible for explicit attach

params.name: attention
params.description: Only list sessions in the needs-you attention class

params.name: board_column
params.description: Repeatable board column filter: needs_you, working, waiting, in_review, done

params.name: badge
params.description: Filter by comma-separated exact session badges

params.name: archive
params.description: Archived session visibility

params.name: later
params.description: Visibility of sessions parked in Later; excluded by default

params.name: sort
params.description: Stable session ordering

params.name: cursor
params.description: Opaque next_cursor from the previous page

params.name: limit
params.description: Sessions per page (1-100)
